name: reelmimic
description: Show it a video you love. Get a new video in the same style. An AI crew (Claude Code or Codex) plans, builds and reviews it with you.
readme: [!NOTE] ⭐ Star and fork counts were reset to zero on October 20, 2026 because the repository was accidentally made private for a short time. The project is still actively maintained. Details in #115. Each one made with ReelMimic from a reference video and a one-line brief. Previews are silent, with the lyrics cropped out.
